hooks.statusMessage: Blixel: connect, status and disconnect when you type them
hooks.command: i=$(/bin/cat); case $i in *'"prompt":"$blixel:'* | *'"prompt":"'[Cc][Oo][Nn][Nn][Ee][Cc][Tt]' '[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll]* | *'"prompt":"'[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll][' :'][Cc][Oo][Nn][Nn][Ee][Cc][Tt]* | *'"prompt":"'[Dd][Ii][Ss][Cc][Oo][Nn][Nn][Ee][Cc][Tt]' '[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll]* | *'"prompt":"'[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll][' :'][Dd][Ii][Ss][Cc][Oo][Nn][Nn][Ee][Cc][Tt]* | *'"prompt":"'[Ss][Tt][Aa][Tt][Uu][Ss]' '[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll]* | *'"prompt":"'[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll][' :'][Ss][Tt][Aa][Tt][Uu][Ss]*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ ${#i} -lt 200000 ] || exit 0; BLIXEL_HOOK_INPUT=$i exec "$PLUGIN_ROOT/prompt.sh"

hooks.statusMessage: Blixel: receive handoffs after you type connect
hooks.command: i=$(/bin/cat); s=${i#*\"session_id\":\"}; s=${s%%\"*}; case $i in *'"prompt":"$blixel:connect'* | *'"prompt":"'[Cc][Oo][Nn][Nn][Ee][Cc][Tt]' '[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll]* | *'"prompt":"'[Bb][Ll][Ii][Xx][Ee][Ll][' :'][Cc][Oo][Nn][Nn][Ee][Cc][Tt]*) ;; *) [ -e "$PLUGIN_DATA/$s/connected" ] || exit 0 ;; esac; [ ${#i} -lt 200000 ] || exit 0; BLIXEL_HOOK_INPUT=$i exec "$PLUGIN_ROOT/receive.sh"
